'''2008 Worlds Day 2 Alden Peterson DS Begin Landing Your Troops''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Alden Peterson]] at [[2008 World Championship]] (Day 2). Starting written Invasion; Destroyer Droid package treated as Begin Landing Your Troops / Occupy.


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Alden Peterson]]
* '''Event:''' [[2008 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Virtual Sets (2002-2009)|Decipher + Virtual Sets (2002-2009)]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Begin Landing Your Troops / Occupy|Begin Landing Your Troops]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
